run_create_places_low_shot_samples: run the script to create low-shot data samples for Places205 SVM training
run_find_num_positives: run find_num_positives to count the number of positive samples per class in target labels
run_sample_data: run sample_data to randomly sample k images per class from image and target arrays
run_generate_independent_sample: run generate_independent_sample to load numpy data files and generate multiple low-shot sample sets
run_main_cli: run the CLI with --images_data_file, --targets_data_file, --output_path, --k_values, and --num_samples arguments
